description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Internship" name="Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends (via Twitter)"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer" sourceRef="SendTask_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer" sourceRef="SendTask_DenyOffer" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CompanyStatus" name="Company status update" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet" sourceRef="SendTask_RecommendCompany" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student Internship Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Search" name="Search started"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterTopic" name="Enter topic of interest"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMoney" name="Enter desired amount of money"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterExperience" name="Enter experience"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterHobbies" name="Enter hobbies"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferMerge" name="Offer awaited"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferReceived" name="Offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Offer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideOffer" name="Accept or deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Offer accepted?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_AcceptOffer" name="Send offer acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VoidOtherOffers" name="Void all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_DenyOffer" name="Send offer denial"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipSplit" name="Internship starts"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentMerge" name="Status update due"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StudentStatusUpdate" name="Write at least 3 status updates per week about internship"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentCheck" name="At least 3 updates written?"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyMerge" name="Company update awaited"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyStatusUpdate" name="Company status update received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyStatus" messageRef="Message_CompanyStatus"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyCheck" name="At least 3 company updates received?"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipJoin" name="Internship finished"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RecommendCompany" name="Send recommendation tweet to each friend">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Recommended" name="Recommendations sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Start_Topic" sourceRef="Start_Search" targetRef="Task_EnterTopic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Topic_Money" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopic" targetRef="Task_EnterMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Money_Experience" sourceRef="Task_EnterMoney" targetRef="Task_EnterExperience"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Experience_Hobbies" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperience" targetRef="Task_EnterHobbies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Hobbies_OfferMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_OfferMerge_Event" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Event_Decide" sourceRef="Event_OfferReceived" targetRef="Task_DecideOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Decision_Accept" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="SendTask_AcceptOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Decision_Deny" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="SendTask_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Accept_Void" sourceRef="SendTask_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_VoidOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Void_Split" sourceRef="Task_VoidOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Deny_OfferMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_DenyOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Split_StudentMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="Gateway_StudentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StudentMerge_Task" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentMerge" targetRef="Task_StudentStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StudentTask_Check" sourceRef="Task_StudentStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_StudentCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StudentCheck_More" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StudentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_StudentCheck_Done" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Split_CompanyMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CompanyMerge_Event" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyMerge" targetRef="Event_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CompanyEvent_Check" sourceRef="Event_CompanyStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CompanyCheck_More" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyCheck" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_CompanyCheck_Done" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyCheck" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Join_Recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin" targetRef="SendTask_RecommendCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Recommend_End" sourceRef="SendTask_RecommendCompany" targetRef="End_Recommended"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyStatus" name="Company status update"/>
</bpmn:definitions>
